portInfo.description: Port of Waterford (commercial state company) lists cruise landings at Belview, Waterford city (berth reopening 2026), and Dunmore East. Belview is the main operations centre 8 km down the Suir from the city. Larger ships may anchor and tender into Dunmore East village. Confirm which of the three models your line uses before planning a walk-off day — city-quay reopening status must be checked against the live call list for 2026.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Belview Port (cruise landing option) — Belview Port, Waterford
gettingThere.distanceToCity: City Quays (when open): walk into the compact historic centre. Belview: plan shuttle/taxi for ~8 km. Dunmore East: tender then regional coach/taxi.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Waterford Viking Triangle / city museums — ~120 min.
Mount Congreve / regional gardens — coach; long call.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Check whether 2026 calls use the reopened city berth, Belview, or Dunmore tender.
